final: WITH media_averages AS (SELECT MediaTypeId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_price, AVG(Bytes * 1.0 / NULLIF(Milliseconds, 0)) AS avg_bytes_per_ms FROM Track GROUP BY MediaTypeId), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bytes_per_ms) AS avg_bytes_per_ms FROM media_averages) SELECT AVG(m.avg_price) AS avg_price, AVG(m.avg_bytes_per_ms) AS avg_bytes_per_ms, AVG(m.avg_bytes_per_ms - o.avg_bytes_per_ms) AS avg_difference FROM media_averages AS m CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o WHERE o.avg_bytes_per_ms IS NOT NULL AND m.avg_bytes_per_ms > o.avg_bytes_per_ms
